H1 One categorical IV – continuous DV prediction

Political beliefs (cat = left to right in 5 steps) 
effect on 
Physical attractiveness (scale = 11 point rating) 

H2 One continuous-continuous prediction

Importance of looking attractive (Attract_importance_1, scale 1-9)
positive effect on
Daily time spent enhancing appearance  (composite variable, sum of 8 scales)

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)
library(reshape2)

```


Load data
```{r}

#load processed data
h1 <- read.csv("data/processed_data/practice_h1.csv")
h2 <- read.csv("data/processed_data/practice_h2.csv")


colnames(h1)
table(h1$cot_politics)

h1$cot_politics <- factor(h1$cot_politics,
                       levels = c("far_left","center_left","center","center_right","far_right"))


```

Plot h1 box

```{r}

h1_box <- ggplot(data = h1, 
                  aes(x = cot_politics,
                      y = self_physatt,
                      fill = cot_politics)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .4) + 
    labs(x = "Political Beliefs", 
       y = "(Self reported) Physical Attractiveness Scale",, 
       title = "Self Reported Physical Attractiveness and Political Beliefs") +
       scale_x_discrete(labels = 
                          c("Far Left", "Center Left", "Center", "Center Right", "Far Right", "NA")) +
  guides(fill = "none") 

h1_box

```

Plot 1 violin

```{r}

h1_violin <- ggplot(data = h1, 
                  aes(x = cot_politics,
                      y = self_physatt,
                      fill = cot_politics)) +
    geom_violin() +
    labs(x = "Self", 
       y = "Points allocated to PPA", 
       title = "Partner Physical Attractivness (PPA) by Sex") +
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 8) +
  geom_boxplot(width=.12)

h1_violin
```



Plot 1 raincloud

```{r}

h1_raincloud <- ggplot(data = h1, 
                  aes(x = cot_politics,
                      y = self_physatt,
                      fill = cot_politics)) +
  geom_rain(alpha=.5,likert=T, point.args = list(size = 0.1)) +
    labs(x = "Sex assigned at birth", 
       y = "Points allocated to PPA", 
       title = "Partner Physical Attractivness (PPA) by Sex") +
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 8)

h1_raincloud

```


##

H2 One continuous-continuous prediction

Importance of looking attractive (Attract_importance_1, scale 1-9)
positive effect on
Daily time spent enhancing appearance  (composite variable, sum of 8 scales)


##
Plots

```{r}

#Scatter Plot with line
h2_line <- ggplot(data = h2, 
                  aes(x = attract_importance_1,
                      y = app_enh_total)) +
                         geom_jitter(width=.12, height=.1, alpha=.08, size = .6)  +
        labs(x = "Reported Importance Of Own Attractivness", 
       y = "Composite Score of Daily Time Spent Enhancing Appearance (min)", 
       title = "Time Spent Enhancing Appearance in Relation to Importance of Appearance") +
  geom_smooth(method="lm")

h2_line



```


Save my figures

```{r}

#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = F)

ggsave(plot = h1_box, "figures/h1_box.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave(plot = h2_line, "figures/h2_line.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
